notes: THREE CHANGES. DATE NOTE: builds v2026.11.11.01 to .09 carried released 2026-11-11 from the test machine's clock; the real date was 2026-11-23. This build uses the real date. 1) INVEST MORE ON THE DECISIONS PAGE. New decision type: pick an investment and a start month. It answers the largest monthly SIP you can sustain at Comfortable, Balanced and Aggressive. Judged against logged numbers with switched-on what-if scenarios as backdrop, over the 60 months from the start month. The candidate SIP is a Change my plan contribution revision, so it follows the grow-contributions setting like every other SIP. Tests: money left over (surplus with lumps added back, minus ALL SIPs) at least 15k / 10k / 5k; cash in the savings chain at least 6 / 4.5 / 3 months of ordinary outflow. Money already invested is NOT counted as cover, because moving cash into a SIP leaves liquid money unchanged. Shows the binding month and test, a start-later table for the next 5 years, the SIP cost of each assumption (Measure), and a button that adds a switched-off Change my plan scenario with the answer. Bisection to Rs 500. Each probe runs the engine only to the end of the window: verified identical inside the window and about 10x faster, roughly 50 ms per answer. 2) COMMIT TO BASE IS A PERMANENT LAYER. It no longer copies parts of a scenario into the inputs, skips the rest and deletes the scenario. A committed scenario stays in the list marked In base plan, with Remove from base. runProjection always applies committed scenarios (_scenariosForProjection), so Projection, Dashboard, Net Worth, Decisions, Budget and Journal include them from their own dates, exactly as their preview did; previews stack on top. Recurring costs (child age-based costs, custom monthly costs) get their own expense category, budget 0, planned from the scenario, which the Journal can log against. A purchase loan becomes a real EMI (fromScenario) and the scenario stops charging its own EMI row, so it is counted once. One-off costs become planned one-time items in plannedOneOffsInMonth, so the Budget tubes and the Journal link picker both see them. Editing a committed scenario re-syncs its category and EMI. Remove from base or delete: the EMI leaves the plan; a category with logged entries stays with budget 0, otherwise it is removed; Journal entries are never touched. Decisions: committed scenarios show as In base and are not toggleable assumptions. Things committed the old way are left as they are. 3) BUDGET PAGE PLANS FROM THE ENGINE (_budgetPlanFor), the same source as the other pages: category budgets now include the yearly step-up and committed revisions; EMI tubes use the shared emiScheduleFor (step-ups, pauses, closes); committed scenario categories, EMIs and one-offs appear. Previews are deliberately not applied on Budget and Journal: they follow the actual plan. Projection sheet and Budget share planFoldFor and _foldKeyForRow, so a revision or committed cost lands in the same row on both. ALSO: typing over a pre-filled amount in Change my plan now keeps the default selected through the mouse release (Safari clears it on mouseup). Previous build passed human-timed clicks in Chrome and failed only an instant click-then-type; new build passes instant, 120 ms and 300 ms clicks. FIXED DURING THIS BUILD: replacing the old commit function deleted the Decisions declarations (DC_LIMITS, DECISION_APPETITES, DECISION_KINDS and two Invest-more constants). They were restored exactly; a diff of every top-level declaration against v2026.11.11.09 shows nothing missing. Also fixed: the recurring-cost check had read other committed scenarios' rows; excludeScenarioIds now only drops committed scenarios. VERIFIED in headless Chromium, real buttons and file picker: 17 Invest-more checks (exact maximum, the created scenario passes all 60 months under the full engine, grow-contributions on/off, closed instrument, car decision unaffected); 25+ commit/Budget/Journal checks (commit equals preview; sheet rows; Budget tubes for own category, EMI, one-time; EMI step-down on Budget; Journal category and link list; remove from base keeps entries; edit re-syncs the EMI; counted once in Decisions; delete; removing everything restores the original numbers exactly); 9 human-click typing checks; all earlier suites pass; engine with no scenarios identical to v2026.05.13.03; phone layout of the new card and result checked at 390px; no page errors. NOT VERIFIED: Safari (no Safari engine here); a real Firebase save. The guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. KNOWN LIMITS: a committed retirement's expense cut reduces totals but is not split per category on the Budget page. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
